authored_branch_proofs.proof: B!=0 gives y=-(A/B)x-C/B with arbitrary real x; B=0 requires A!=0 and gives x=-C/A with arbitrary real y. A=B=0 is instead identity or contradiction.
A reversible reduction to 0=0 is true for every admissible x in that domain; 0=c with c!=0 is false for all. The domain is not expanded from rationals to reals by the reduction.

authored_branch_proofs.claim: Exact decimal notation can be a solution
authored_branch_proofs.proof: For exact solution s of ax=b, residual at q is a(q-s). 2*(1/2)=1, so decimal0.5 is exact; 3*(333/1000)-1=-1/1000.

authored_branch_proofs.claim: Clear only specified nonzero constant integer denominators
authored_branch_proofs.proof: Their positive LCM is nonzero, so multiplying by it has an inverse. Variable denominators need separate original-domain exclusions.
